rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE SALE OF MOTOR VEHICLES IN METRO MANILA BY REQUIRING A PROOF-OF-PARKING SPACE OR GARAGE FACILITY FROM MOTOR VEHICLE BUYERS AS A PREREQUISITE FOR THE PURCHASE OF A MOTOR VEHICLE AND REGISTRATION WITH THE LAND TRANSPORTATION OFFICE
rows.abstract:
Proposes to institute a No Parking or Garage, No Car policy aims to lessen traffic congestion, curb the number of private vehicles, provide safe and uncluttered pathways where people may freely walk through space for ongoing human and vehicular traffic.

Provides that any person with residence or business address in Metro Manila who intends to purchase a motor vehicle, shall be required to execute an affidavit, attesting to the availability of a permanent parking space or facility or such has been leased or procured specifically for the purpose.

rows.author: H077;
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TOTAL BAN ON THE IMPORT AND EXPORT OF WASTES, PROVIDING MEANS FOR ITS ENFORCEMENT, APPROPRIATIONS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Intends to address the issue as regards the practice of other countries and companies overseas like Canada, South Korea, Australia and Hongkong of sending their garbage to the Philippines which is an insult to all Filipinos and an affront to our laws.

Tasks the DENR, DOF, DOT to jointly establish an Environmental Protection Desk at every port of entry in the country to be manned 24 hours a day and seven days a week by competent and adequately trained personnel.

States that the relevant penal provision of environmental and customs law as provided herein shall apply as penalties to violations of this Act.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE IMPORTATION OF SOLID WASTE MATERIALS
rows.abstract:
Provides for the definition of solid waste as defined in R.A. No.9003 and its IRR as follows:

\"Solid waste shall refer to all discarded household, commercial waste, non-hazardous institutional and industrial waste, street sweepings, construction debris, agricultural waste, and other non-hazardous/non-toxic solid waste.\"

Penalizes any entity or person, foreigner, business entity owner/president/manager/sr. officers, or government official/employees who shall import any solid waste for use, treatment, or processing in violation of this Act with corresponding punishment and liabilities.
